content:
Grand Onam Sadhya

Time: 01:00 PM - 02:30 PM

Venue: College Dining Hall / Food Court

Coordinator: Hospitality & Food Committee

The grand traditional vegetarian feast served on fresh plantain leaves, featuring authentic Kerala delicacies celebrating the harvest festival.

Sadhya Highlights

  • Serving Style: Traditional feast served on fresh banana leaf
  • Seating: Batch-wise seating arrangement for all students, staff, and guests
  • Varieties: Over 20 authentic traditional dishes, curries, pickles, and crispy snacks

Menu & Delicacies

Rice & Main Curries

Kerala Matta Rice, Parippu with Ghee, Sambar, Moru Curry, Pulissery, and Rasam.

Side Dishes

Avial, Thoran, Olan, Kalan, Erissery, Pachadi, and Kichadi.

Accompaniments

Sharkara Varatti, Banana Chips (Upperi), Inji Puli, Lime Pickle, and Papadam.

Dessert (Payasam)

Traditional Ada Pradhaman and creamy Palada Payasam.
